note: Five source-backed business-role examples, not exhaustive insurance membership. No policyholder/customer records accessed, paid holdings, weights, revenue materiality or historical membership inferred.
comparison_note: Life, general and health underwriting, reinsurance and distribution platforms use different accounting and operating metrics. Distributed premium is not broker revenue; network hospitals are not owned hospital assets. This is not a homogeneous valuation peer group.

members.rationale: HDFC Life offers long-term life, protection, pension and annuity solutions. It is the listed insurer, not all HDFC Bank businesses; product breadth is not current new-business growth.
